label: Codex Forster II
summary: Leonardo notebook volume in the Victoria and Albert Museum, London, MSL/1876/Forster/141/II. Two notebooks bound together before 1608 to 1614: II1 (ff. 1 to 63v) c.1495, II2 (ff. 64r to 160v) c.1495 to 1497, Milan.
contents: notes connected with the Last Supper (first part)
weights, traction, stresses and balances (second part)
history: bought in Vienna by Robert Bulwer Lytton (1862 per Scala)
bequeathed by Forster to the South Kensington (now V&A) Museum, 1876

claims.statement: V&A shelfmark MSL/1876/Forster/141/II. The V&A holds five notebooks bound in three volumes, probably in the seventeenth century, not in logical order.
